message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. `postSlug` now splits accented letters into the base letter plus its accent mark and removes the marks before calling the slugifier.

I didn't change the slugifier in `vendor/slugify/`, because its header says not to edit it by hand. The shop's `productUrl` also uses it, so shop URLs still drop accented letters. If you want the same fix there, it would be a similar one-line change in `src/shop/product-url.js`.
